spirePolicy: Preserve each castle's original silhouette and height. Turret upgrades reinforce mounting collar, support frame and tower trim together; no separate spire upgrade category.
requirements: Within-castle upgrade stages change core installations and silhouettes, not just prop count or material finish
Between-castle layouts and activities differ, including farming animals, aquaculture, research, exercise, pools and hydrotherapy
Advanced turrets are supported by matching missile/laser/energy/control/cooling science facilities
Later castles are much more ornate, luxurious and powerful while keeping overall colors and ambient lighting subdued
Small diverse functional details and clear companion walking lanes; no fine high-resolution painting overpowering CMF sprites
Distribute health facilities across inn, exercise gym, steam therapy, onsen, swimming and bioenergy recovery rather than repeating bedrooms or pools.
Vitality rooms intentionally differ: rustic inn, desert bath, knight gym, sea-water therapy, steam sauna, mechanical fitness, onsen, swimming center, bioenergy recovery and royal spa.
